verification_scope: source line/hash binding only; behavioral verification unmeasured

rules.statement: Each successfully read transaction resets its validation reason. Reason zero selects posting; any nonzero reason increments reject count and writes a reject record.
rules.falsifier: A nonzero validation reason reaches posting, or a rejected input is neither counted nor written.
rules.proposed_public_case: One valid transaction, one invalid card, then one valid transaction; assert validation state is reset between records.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: After normal file closure, at least one rejected transaction sets RETURN-CODE to 4.
rules.falsifier: A normally completed run with one reject returns a code other than 4.
rules.proposed_public_case: Compare normal completion with one reject against an all-valid run; do not infer the all-valid return code from this conditional alone.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Cross-reference lookup precedes account lookup; an invalid card sets reason 100 and suppresses account validation.
rules.falsifier: Missing XREF causes an account lookup or a reason other than 100 before reject emission.
rules.proposed_public_case: Use a nonexistent synthetic card with a separate account lookup counter.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Account lookup uses XREF-ACCT-ID; INVALID KEY assigns reason 101.
rules.falsifier: The transaction card is used as the account key, or a missing account proceeds to posting.
rules.proposed_public_case: Provide a valid card-to-account link whose account record is absent.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Temporary balance is current-cycle credit minus current-cycle debit plus transaction amount. A value above the credit limit assigns reason 102; equality passes this check.
rules.falsifier: Equality is rejected, or a value one cent above the limit passes this check with a nonexpired account.
rules.proposed_public_case: Set cycle credit=90.00, debit=10.00, amount=20.00, limit=100.00, then amount=20.01; keep expiry valid.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: The account expiry date is compared with the first ten characters of original transaction timestamp. An earlier expiry assigns reason 103 after the credit-limit check, so expiry failure overwrites 102.
rules.falsifier: A transaction failing both checks retains reason 102, or equality of dates fails solely on expiry.
rules.proposed_public_case: Use over-limit and expired input, then same-day expiry; retain exact fixed-width date strings.
rules.limits: Lexical source comparison, not a newly validated calendar/parser contract; malformed dates and field encodings need independent cases.

rules.statement: Posting copies transaction fields, computes processing time, then updates category balance, updates account and writes the transaction in that order.
rules.falsifier: Transaction output is written before either balance update, or an original timestamp is silently used as processing time.
rules.proposed_public_case: Instrument public fixture I/O order and distinguish original versus processing timestamps.
rules.limits: No atomicity or rollback guarantee follows from this sequential call order.

rules.statement: Category balance is keyed by XREF account, transaction type and category. A missing key selects creation; creation initializes the record and adds the amount.
rules.falsifier: Different category/type records are combined, or a missing category starts with stale balance data.
rules.proposed_public_case: Two transaction types and categories for one synthetic account; include one previously absent key.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: An existing category balance adds the transaction amount and rewrites the record. A nonzero rewrite status enters the error/abend path.
rules.falsifier: The amount replaces an existing balance or a failed rewrite is treated as success.
rules.proposed_public_case: Start at 10.00, apply -3.00, expect 7.00 before testing a forced rewrite failure.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: All amounts add to current balance. Nonnegative amounts add to cycle credit; negative amounts add, with their sign intact, to cycle debit.
rules.falsifier: A negative amount is made positive before adding to cycle debit, or zero selects the debit branch.
rules.proposed_public_case: Use +2.00, 0.00 and -2.00 against independently captured before/after account records.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Account rewrite INVALID KEY sets reason 109; the caller still performs the following transaction-write paragraph. This extraction does not invent an abort or second validation branch.
rules.falsifier: The proposed source-faithful account-rewrite path automatically revalidates or aborts before transaction output despite these statements.
rules.proposed_public_case: Force account rewrite INVALID KEY and retain subsequent I/O calls and reason 109.
rules.limits: Potential product behavior requiring review; not an endorsement. Do not fix a frozen source path under this catalogue work.

rules.statement: Blank or low-value account input sets INPUT-ERROR and blank flag, clears both account identifiers, and exits account editing.
rules.falsifier: Blank input is admitted or leaves a prior account identifier available for a new lookup.
rules.proposed_public_case: Submit blank input after a previously selected synthetic account; check both identifiers.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Supplied account input must be numeric and nonzero in its fixed-width field; otherwise editing fails and CDEMO-ACCT-ID is cleared.
rules.falsifier: Alphabetic input or all zeroes receives the valid account flag.
rules.proposed_public_case: Use fixed-width zero, alphabetic and nonzero numeric values.
rules.limits: The text says eleven digits; exact field size and receive-map behavior also require their own source bindings for end-to-end input-length claims.

rules.statement: A mandatory edit field fails when its selected substring is low-values, spaces or empty after trimming; otherwise the mandatory-valid flag is set.
rules.falsifier: A whitespace-only required name passes mandatory editing.
rules.proposed_public_case: Exercise low-values, spaces, and a nonblank synthetic name with declared field length.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Low-values, spaces or zeroes fail the yes/no edit as missing. Other values must satisfy the existing FLG-YES-NO-ISVALID condition.
rules.falsifier: A missing flag passes or an invalid condition value receives no input error.
rules.proposed_public_case: Use each missing sentinel and condition-valid/invalid values; bind the condition definition before claiming case normalization.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: FICO values outside FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID set INPUT-ERROR and the FICO-not-OK flag; the source definition is inclusive 300 through 850.
rules.falsifier: 299 or 851 is admitted, or 300 or 850 fails solely the range check.
rules.proposed_public_case: Public values 299,300,850,851 after numeric editing.
rules.limits: Additional definition binding: COACTUPC.cbl lines 845–849; missing/non-numeric handling occurs before this paragraph.

rules.statement: Valid changed details first enter an unconfirmed state. Write processing occurs in the unconfirmed state only with PF05; otherwise it continues without saving.
rules.falsifier: Ordinary Enter saves the changed records without the PF05 confirmation branch.
rules.proposed_public_case: Edit a valid field, press Enter, then PF05; compare call trace before and after confirmation.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Write processing reads the account for update and exits on a non-NORMAL response before reading/updating the customer.
rules.falsifier: An account lock failure reaches a customer update or either rewrite.
rules.proposed_public_case: Inject a public synthetic non-NORMAL account read response and capture ordered CICS operations.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: After account read-for-update succeeds, customer read-for-update must return NORMAL; otherwise INPUT-ERROR is set and write processing exits.
rules.falsifier: A customer lock failure proceeds to account or customer rewrite.
rules.proposed_public_case: Account NORMAL followed by customer non-NORMAL; assert zero rewrites.
rules.limits: Lock release behavior is not proven by this paragraph alone.

rules.statement: The old/new record check runs before preparing updates; its changed-data flag exits write processing before rewriting.
rules.falsifier: An externally changed field detected by 9700 is overwritten by the proposed update.
rules.proposed_public_case: Change one compared public field between screen display and update-lock read.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: Account stale-data checks compare numeric/date fields exactly while account group is compared after LOWER-CASE.
rules.falsifier: Case-only account-group differences alone produce the changed-data flag, or a compared balance difference is missed.
rules.proposed_public_case: Keep all other captured fields equal; vary group case, then vary current balance.
rules.limits: This is the account portion only; customer checks have their own conditions and date slicing.

rules.statement: Account rewrite precedes customer rewrite; a non-NORMAL account rewrite sets update-failed and exits.
rules.falsifier: Customer rewrite occurs after a failed account rewrite.
rules.proposed_public_case: Inject account rewrite failure after both locks and stale checks succeed.
rules.limits: Source-derived rule; no new native or candidate execution has been measured.

rules.statement: A non-NORMAL customer rewrite sets update-failed and explicitly requests SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK.
rules.falsifier: Customer rewrite failure returns without requesting rollback.
rules.proposed_public_case: Account rewrite NORMAL, customer rewrite non-NORMAL; capture rollback request and independently verify resulting stored state.
rules.limits: Requesting rollback is not measured proof of transactional rollback across a target implementation.
